# Elliott J. Fils, CPA

Elliott J. Fils, CPA is a solo certified public accounting practice at 15260 Ventura Blvd., Suite 1200, Sherman Oaks, California.
Elliott Fils is a former CFO in Los Angeles communications and public relations, with more than 25 years advising entrepreneurs and businesses under $30 million in revenue.
We prepare federal and California tax returns for individuals and business owners, and plan before the year closes.
We provide business management: bookkeeping, financial projections, budgeting, and reporting.
We provide CFO and controller services, including internal reporting and cash-flow visibility, for companies that are not ready for a full-time hire.
We provide personal financial management for high-net-worth households, covering banking relationships and asset decisions.
Elliott does the work himself rather than passing it to rotating staff.
The initial consultation is free.
We serve Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Encino, and greater Los Angeles.
Phone: (818) 501-7717.
Email: elliott@filscpa.com.
Website: https://www.filscpa.com/
